notes.title: Update r-1.0
notes.content:
The reward level from a chest dropped by ordinary opponents is determined by the probability 1/2/3/4/5 - 40%/30%/20%/8%/2%
The reward level of a chest dropped from bosses or elite opponents is always the maximum (5)
The reward from a chest now has a 50/50 chance of either increasing a random attribute by 2/4/6/10/15 or giving 10/20/30/50/100 gold, depending on its level
The reward from the chest no longer contains improved techniques/items.

notes.title: Update r-0.9
notes.content:
- Updated enemy stats
- Updated character stats
- Updated buffs from passive talents
- Expanded technique descriptions
- The chest pickup radius no longer depends on the general item pickup radius. Now, you must approach the chest closely to pick it up
- Added descriptions for techniques and items in a tooltip window when hovering over their icons

notes.title: Update r-0.8
notes.content:
1. Added a feature of enemy speed gradually change after being spawned. This only applies to normal enemies. Acceleration starts after 2 seconds being spawned, each second gain 0.5 movement speed.
2. Added evasion stat to enemy and precision stat to player. Enemies have chances to evade player's attacks base on their evasion stat value, but player's precision stat can increase the chance of hitting the enemy.
3. All enemies have a chance 1% to drop chests.

notes.title: Update r-0.5
notes.content:
- when killing Ascension beast and picking up Treasure added popup about reward
- Value of attribute increase for chest now does not depend on type and always 10
- Changed timings of rewards for kill "Ascension beast". Nowwhen "Ascension beast" was killed during 1/2/3 minutes, then rewards increase attributes by (5 * player level) and 500 gold/attribute increse by (3 * player level) and 500 gold/500 gold
